Four Indian sailors killed in attack on cargo ship off Ukraine

A Russian strike on a cargo ship off Ukraine's coast in Odesa killed four Indian sailors and critically injured another. India has condemned the attack and summoned the Russian envoy. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar raised the issue of Indian seafarers' safety with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov.
